profiles.quote: Every day felt kinder with you beside us.
profiles.story: Milo greeted us at the door with his favorite toy. We remember our long walks, his wet nose and the quiet sound of him sleeping beside the sofa.
profiles.favorite: Walks by the lake, a ball and naps beside the family.

profiles.quote: Our little patch of sunshine at home.
profiles.story: Luna always found the sunniest spot by the window. In the evenings she settled beside our books and filled the room with gentle purring.
profiles.favorite: Sunny windowsills, paper bags and a soft blanket.

profiles.quote: Every walk brings back a memory of you.
profiles.story: Richie loved discovering new paths and always looked back to check we were close. Even a short walk became an adventure with him.
profiles.favorite: Woodland trails, autumn leaves and playing with sticks.

profiles.quote: Your gentle purr stays with us.
profiles.story: Bella arrived on a quiet autumn evening. Before long she had claimed the cozy armchair and become our companion through every household task.
profiles.favorite: Her armchair, ribbons and watching birds.

profiles.quote: So much joy in one wagging tail.
profiles.story: Charlie could make us smile with a single look. He loved visitors and was always the first to greet anyone coming home.
profiles.favorite: Meadow games, country trips and meeting friends.

profiles.quote: Thank you for the quiet happiness of being close.
profiles.story: Busya always found a spot beside us. We cherish memories of her soft paws and her habit of napping on the edge of our desk.
profiles.favorite: Boxes, warm blankets and quiet evenings together.

profiles.quote: Our faithful friend on every road.
profiles.story: Oscar joined us on trips and walks. He especially loved stopping by the water, where we could watch the distance and rest together.
profiles.favorite: Road trips, walks by the water and his soft toy.

profiles.quote: You brought so much light into our home.
profiles.story: Nika explored every corner and found new places to sleep. Her curiosity made ordinary days a little brighter.
profiles.favorite: Rustling toys, high shelves and morning sunshine.

diagnostics.title: Performance diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Record a run, compare controlled scenarios and review saved results.
diagnostics.fpsHelp: This caps the animation ticker. It is not a measurement of browser FPS.
diagnostics.collectHelp: Live readings are hidden. Recording starts only with Start recording. Controls, saved results and JSON downloads remain available.
diagnostics.activeHelp: Rates and active CPU readings exclude pauses, hidden tabs and offscreen scenes. Closing this panel does not stop collection. Live values refresh twice per second.
diagnostics.cpuHelp: CPU readings measure JavaScript work and render submission, not GPU time. All rendering includes manual redraws while paused. Percentiles use retained samples; — means no samples yet.
diagnostics.scenarioHelp: Up to 80 characters. Use a short label without personal details.
diagnostics.privacy: Reports contain performance and device details. Pet names, stories and author information are not collected.
diagnostics.recordingHelp: Opening or closing this panel never starts or stops manual recording. A change of conditions saves the current run and starts a separate one while recording is active.
diagnostics.benchmarkHelp: Steady scenarios use 3 seconds of warm-up, 15 seconds of measurement and 3 repeats per garden. The full suite takes several minutes. Keep this panel open: closing it cancels the benchmark to preserve its conditions.
diagnostics.currentWindow: Latest active window · up to 2 s
diagnostics.resultsHelp: The latest 12 runs stay in this page session. Download a result to keep its complete timings and conditions.
diagnostics.noResults: Stop a recording or finish a benchmark to save a result here.

items.question: Is creating a memorial free?
items.answer: Yes. You can create a memorial and save your pet’s story for free. You’ll need an account with a confirmed email address.

items.question: Who can read the story?
items.answer: Anyone visiting the garden, including people without an account. Remaining anonymous only hides your name as the author: your pet’s name and story stay public.

items.question: Can I change the story later?
items.answer: Yes. Open your memorial from your account and select the pencil in its full story card. You can change your pet’s details, story and author name visibility. The spot in the garden stays the same.

items.question: How can I invite friends and family?
items.answer: Open the memorial and copy the link from your address bar. It leads straight to your pet’s story. No account is needed to read it.
